units.source_text: 三条宫邸遭了火灾之后，薰君移居六条院内，与匂亲王居处相距甚近，常常前往访问。

en.t: After the Sanjo palace residence was damaged by fire, Lord Kaoru moved into the Rokujo-in, very close to Prince Niou's quarters, and often went to visit him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也觉得他迁来后有许多方便。

en.t: Prince Niou also felt that Kaoru's move there made many things more convenient.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得这里很清静，真是优良的住处。

en.t: Lord Kaoru found the place very quiet and thought it truly an excellent residence.

units.source_text: 庭中花木也与别处迥异，同一种花，同一种草木，这里的特别美丽。

en.t: The flowers and trees in the garden were also quite unlike those elsewhere; even the same flowers and plants seemed especially beautiful here.

units.source_text: 映入池塘的月影，也像画中所绘的一样。

en.t: The moonlight reflected in the pond looked as though it had been painted in a picture.

units.source_text: 匂亲王正如薰君所料，已经起身。

en.t: Just as Lord Kaoru had expected, Prince Niou was already up.

units.source_text: 他闻得风中飘来一阵阵特别芬芳的香气，知道是薰君来了。

en.t: Catching waves of an unusually fragrant scent drifting on the wind, he knew that Lord Kaoru had arrived.

units.source_text: 连忙穿上常礼服，整一整衣冠，出来迎候。

en.t: He hurriedly put on his ordinary formal robes, straightened his attire and headgear, and came out to receive him.

units.source_text: 薰君升阶，不曾走到廊上，便在台阶上坐下。

en.t: Lord Kaoru climbed the steps but did not go as far as the veranda, instead sitting down on the stairway.

units.source_text: 匂亲王没有请他再往上走，自己也在走廊的栏杆边坐下，纵谈世事。

en.t: Prince Niou did not invite him to come farther up, but sat down himself by the veranda railing and talked freely about worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在谈话中想起了宇治两女公子，一味埋怨薰君不肯替他出力。

en.t: During their conversation, Prince Niou remembered the two young ladies of Uji and kept reproaching Lord Kaoru for refusing to help him.

units.source_text: 薰君自忖：“真没道理啊！

en.t: Lord Kaoru thought to himself, "How unreasonable!

units.source_text: 我自己都还不曾到手呢。”

en.t: I have not even won anyone for myself yet."

units.source_text: 继而又想：“我帮他把二女公子弄到手吧。

en.t: Then he thought again, "Perhaps I should help him win the second young lady.

units.source_text: 那时我自己的事也就成功了。”

en.t: Then my own affair will succeed as well."

units.source_text: 便比往常更认真地同他商谈应采取的办法。

en.t: So he discussed the course they should take with him more earnestly than usual.

units.source_text: 破晓时分，可巧发起雾来。

en.t: Toward daybreak, as luck would have it, a mist began to rise.

units.source_text: 天色迷离，月亮蒙上了雾，树荫光线幽暗，颇饶雅趣。

en.t: The sky grew hazy, the moon was veiled in mist, and the light beneath the trees was dim, giving the scene a deeply elegant charm.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想起了宇治山乡岑寂的光景，对薰君说：“这几天内你往宇治，务必带我同去，不可把我扔下啊！”

en.t: Prince Niou recalled the lonely scenery of the mountain village at Uji and said to Lord Kaoru, "If you go to Uji in the next few days, you must take me with you; do not leave me behind!"

units.source_text: 薰君终觉麻烦，面有难色。

en.t: Lord Kaoru still found it troublesome, and a troubled look came over his face.

units.source_text: 匂亲王戏赠诗云：

en.t: Prince Niou playfully presented him with a poem, saying:
